title: Lead AI Solutions Consultant
description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution** 




  





 At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission\-critical work.
 



  





**Why Skan AI** 




  





 We're in hyper\-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
 



  





 Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
 



  





 Our diverse, collaborative team of 250\+ innovators is solving category\-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross\-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.
 



  





 AI Solutions is our global post\-sales and professional\-services organization — the team that takes process intelligence and agentic AI out of pilots and into production, and owns customer outcomes end\-to\-end. We are AI\-first by default: we spot repeating patterns and build agents to automate them, scaling the value we deliver with the book of business, not with headcount.
 



  





**The role.** 
 The design authority and quality bar for the team — a functional\-governance role for the most technical, most trusted consultant in the room. You set the solution\-quality bar across the whole team, frame and gate\-review the hardest solutions before they ship, build the industry\-specific playbooks and reusable AI assets that scale everyone, and lead from the front, hands\-on, on the toughest work. Additionally, you own your own book of accounts end\-to\-end — these are the highest\-impact, most strategic accounts the company has. You begin to own top\-line and margin alongside delivery leadership. For a seasoned leader from a top consulting firm or SI who wants to build, ship and set the standard, this is the seat.
 



  





**What you own** 



* Full end\-to\-end ownership of your own book — the highest\-impact, most strategic accounts the company has (across industries such as BFSI and healthcare), owned from discovery to realized value.
* Design authority and the solution\-quality bar across the team — you frame the hardest problems and gate\-review solutions before they ship.
* Industry\-specific playbooks and reusable AI assets that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
* Leading from the front — hands\-on where the solution stretches beyond out\-of\-the\-box — and coaching the Seniors.
* Top\-line and margin awareness — beginning to own the delivery\-leadership economics alongside delivery leadership.



**What we look for** 



* 8\+ years with deep, demonstrable end\-to\-end delivery leadership on strategic accounts; top consulting\-firm / SI leaders who now build and ship, not just advise.
* Principal\-level technical depth and architecture judgment — sets standards, builds playbooks, raises the bar for others.
* Industry depth (BFSI, healthcare or similar) and the ability to build reusable, industry\-specific assets.
* Commercial awareness — comfortable reasoning about utilization, top\-line and margin.
* Solutions\-led leader who leads by example; heavily hands\-on at the highest bar.



**The persona \& bar** 



* **Thrives in uncertainty:** 
 Can run a substantive, back\-and\-forth customer conversation, build on a fuzzy idea, and convert uncertainty into certainty — Idea → Implementation → Impact. Customers are under pressure and want someone who guides and coaches them.
* **Pragmatic solutioning:** 
 Navigates roadblocks and imperfect systems without waiting to be told what to do — independent judgment over guidance\-dependence.
* **Data\-first, value\-driven (not task execution):** 
 The real work isn't just executing the task in front of you. You own the step before — figuring out what data matters to create foresight on what to optimize — and the step after — the 'what next' that turns insight into value — keeping everything aligned to the customer's bigger goals.
* **AI\-first by default:** 
 Collects data first, then builds agents to optimize workflows — moving past large, manual analyst\-and\-developer teams.
* **Ownership, agility, client\-facing:** 
 Continuous contact with the customer and heavy ownership across every one of these dimensions.



**How the role works** 



* **Our priorities, in order:** 
 product expert (trained and certified on Skan), AI\-first (agents do the repeat work — every consultant a 10x consultant), solutions\-led (solve the true business problem), and end\-to\-end ownership from discovery through adoption.
* **The bar:** 
 you solve real customer problems, and you independently lead a customer discovery session — turning discovery and ideas into a clear plan to ship and adopt an AI solution.
* **Hands\-on and technical:** 
 you set the solution bar, gate\-review the toughest work, and still build from the front where it counts.



  





*Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate.* 




*We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.*

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**About Agora**
 Agora is the global leader in real\-time engagement, providing developers with simple, flexible, and powerful APIs to embed real\-time conversational AI, voice, video, interactive live streaming, and chat into their applications and IoT devices. Headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, Agora is trusted by over 1,700 leading organizations across the globe to power best\-in\-class real\-time experiences from social media and live shopping to education and telehealth.
   

  

****Job Title:****
 Solutions Architect
   

  

****Location:****
 Hybrid (Delhi/ Bangalore)
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a
 ****Solution Architect****
 at Agora, you’ll act as the technical expert bridging customer vision with Agora’s platform. You will design scalable architectures, lead complex integrations, and serve as a trusted advisor to strategic partners and enterprise customers building real\-time engagement applications. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on architecting robust technical solutions, enjoys teamwork, and loves collaborating with customers to bring ambitious ideas to life.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with Sales teams to support revenue growth by aligning Agora’s real\-time engagement, conversational AI, and Agent Studio solutions with customer business drivers, operational challenges, and strategic use cases.
* Collaborate with mid\-market to enterprise customers and partners to understand technical requirements, architecture constraints, scalability goals, security considerations, and user experience expectations.
* Design, document, and propose scalable, secure, low\-latency, and high\-performance architectures leveraging Agora’s SDKs, APIs, Conversational AI stack, RTC infrastructure, and cloud\-native services.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, deep dives, proof\-of\-concepts (POCs), and live demonstrations to validate solution fit and accelerate customer adoption.
* Provide expert\-level technical guidance to solution engineers, developers, customers, and partners during solution design, implementation, deployment, optimization, troubleshooting, and production scaling phases.
* Utilize modern AI\-assisted development and productivity tools such as Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and related AI engineering workflows to accelerate prototyping, integrations, troubleshooting, and solution delivery.
* Work cross\-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Support teams to drive revenue goals, improve customer experience, and influence product direction based on market feedback.
* Design and present highly customized solution demonstrations and architecture narratives tailored to customer\-specific workflows, operational challenges, and industry use cases.
* Contribute to internal enablement assets including reference architectures, solution playbooks, integration guides, demo frameworks, technical documentation, support manuals, and reusable use case templates.
* Stay current with emerging trends and innovations across Conversational AI, Voice AI, Generative AI, WebRTC, real\-time engagement, cloud communications, and developer tooling to proactively advise customers and internal teams.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor for customers by balancing business objectives, product capabilities, compliance considerations, scalability requirements, and long\-term platform strategy.


**Qualifications And Necessary Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 7 to 9 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Pre\-Sales, Technical Consulting, Developer Support, or Software Development.
* Strong programming skills in at least one modern language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Swift, or Kotlin.
* Experience with modern development frameworks such as React Native or Flutter.
* Familiarity with enterprise tools including Salesforce, JIRA, Zendesk, and Confluence.
* Hands\-on expertise in Conversational AI, Voice AI, WebRTC, SIP/PSTN integrations, real\-time streaming, LLM orchestration, ASR/TTS, MCP/function calling frameworks, and AI\-driven engagement systems.
* Solid understanding of SDK integrations, REST APIs, and mobile/web application architectures.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with the ability to design innovative and scalable solutions.


**Nice To Have Skills**
* Familiarity with telecom ecosystems including SIP, PSTN, and CPaaS platforms.
* Understanding of security, compliance, and encryption standards for real\-time communications and AI systems.
* Experience with multi\-region deployments, scalability, and low\-latency optimization.
* Contributions to developer communities, open\-source project

title: Life Sciences – Domain Consultant
description:
**About The Role**
 As a Domain Strategist – Life Sciences, you will make an impact by crafting compelling, insight\-led proposals and bid responses for life sciences clients across the pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and diagnostics sectors. You will be a valued member of the Life Sciences Business Development team and work collaboratively with Sales and Solutioning teams to map client needs to solution capabilities and communicate clear business value to clients and key stakeholders.
   

  

**In this role, you will**
* Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Solutioning teams, articulating the business value of Cognizant Moment solutions within the Life Sciences industry and converting client business requirements into domain\-led solution options.
* Drive domain content for proposals and bids, including win themes, solution storyboards, qualification responses, battle cards, and competitive one\-pagers that help sales quickly articulate differentiation.
* Stay current on the Life Sciences ecosystem of product partners and Cognizant proprietary industry solutions and accelerators, mapping client use cases to strengthen proposal differentiation.
* Curate reusable solution assets and reference architectures that accelerate proposal turnaround for Life Sciences opportunities.
* Contribute to Life Sciences practice offerings, case studies, and thought leadership, mentor junior BD and pre\-sales associates, and provide market intelligence on competitor positioning and emerging client needs.


**Work model**
 At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore, Hyderabad, or Kolkata. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
   

  

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
   

  

**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**
* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, or business; MBA or relevant master's preferred.
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in business development, pre\-sales, or consulting, with at least 5\+ years focused on the Life Sciences industry.
* Understanding of commercial value chains, medical affairs, patient support programs, field\-force effectiveness, and omni\-channel engagement models.
* Functional and strategic expertise in Life Sciences CRM platforms (e.g., Veeva Systems, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud) and digital experience portals.
* Proven experience supporting Life Sciences pursuits, client presentations, and solution demonstrations, with strong executive presence and excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.


**These will help you stand out**
* Strong domain understanding of the life sciences industry and its technology landscape.
* Awareness of CX, CRM, and Digital Experience concepts relevant to pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and diagnostics clients.
* Ability to engage consultatively across stakeholders, from sales teams to client executives.
* Strong research synthesis and analysis skills to convert market and client insights into compelling proposal content.


 We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to prospective customers in the US market. You will own the technical evaluation journey end\-to\-end, from the first discovery call to closing the deal, by demonstrating how our platform solves real\-world data integration challenges. This role involves working closely with global customers (primarily North America ), designing scalable architectures, running tailored product demos, and building proofs\-of\-concept that showcase value.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations, primarily with customers in North America and Europe, and you will own them end\-to\-end.
* Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo fits into their existing data stack (e. g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4 Snowflake, dbt).
* Run live product demos tailored to the customer's stack. These are not scripted walkthroughs. You will need to read the room, adapt on the fly, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.
* Own the technical evaluation from the first conversation to the closed deal by addressing deep technical questions and earning trust with engineering teams.
* Build proofs\-of\-concept by configuring real pipelines from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.
* Develop deep expertise in the data integration landscape, including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) as well as other data pipeline and integration platforms, and articulate Hevo's technical advantages in a way that lands with both technical and non\-technical buyers.
* Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins and with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs after a deal closes.
* Share customer feedback and patterns with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 2 to 4 years of hands\-on experience as a Data engineer, Analytics engineer, ETL/ELT developer, or Data warehouse engineer.
* Experience building and operating real data pipelines in production, including handling source schema changes, failures, and reliability issues.
* Strong fundamentals in SQL and at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).
* Experience with at least one orchestration or transformation tool (Airflow, dbt, or similar).
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* This is non\-negotiable. You will be the face of Hevo's technical capability to a global customer base. That means:
* Your spoken English is clear, confident, and easy to follow for an international audience.
* You are comfortable presenting to groups of 5 to 15 people, including senior technical leaders, over video calls.
* You can structure a technical narrative, not just answer questions but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion.
* You can hold your own when a customer pushes back or challenges your recommendation.
* You have presented or demoed something technical to an audience before, in any context: internal reviews, client calls, meetups, or conferences.
* Genuine interest in customer\-facing work, even if you have not done it formally before.



  





**Good to have:** 



* Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms, whether cloud\-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or Google Cloud Dataflow) or third\-party pipeline and integration tools.
* Exposure to multiple source system types such as CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.
* Public technical writing, conference talks, or open\-source contributions.
* Prior experience in customer conversations, even informally. For example, presenting to internal stakeholders or analytics teams or working with international teams across time zones.

title: Senior Presales
description:
**BCITS PRIVATE LIMITED** 




**Powering Utility Digitalization Since 1999** 




  





**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




 Presales – Utility Solutions (AMI, Metering, Billing \& Revenue Management)
 



**Department:** 
 Presales \& Business Development
 



**Function:** 
 RFP Analysis, Deliverable Mapping \& Internal Cost Estimation
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Chief Executive Officer
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka (travel for pre\-bid meetings and site visits as required)
 



**Industry Domain:** 
 Power, Water \& Gas Utilities AMI, Smart Metering, MDAS/MDM, Billing \& Revenue Management
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**ABOUT BCITS** 




 BCITS Private Limited, incorporated in 1999 and headquartered in Bengaluru, is a technology partner to the power, water and gas utility sector. Over 25 years, BCITS has delivered more than 100 projects across India as an OEM and system integrator in Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), Meter Data Acquisition, Revenue \& Billing Management, Meter Data Management, CIS, CRM, GIS and Smart/Spot Metering solutions.
 



 Empaneled by the Power Finance Corporation (PFC) as a Meter Data Acquisition Solution Provider under R\-APDRP, BCITS works with state distribution utilities and large System Integrators/EPCs (AMISPs) on turnkey programs that reduce losses, improve revenue and enhance customer service. BCITS is strengthening its presales function to bid accurately and competitively across AMI, RDSS and digital utility transformation programs.
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




 Every bid BCITS submits rests on one internal document: the cost sheet. It converts the RFP's scope, deliverables, SLAs and contract terms into every rupee BCITS will spend to execute the project. If the sheet misses a cost, BCITS wins the bid and loses money. If it overstates cost, BCITS prices itself out and does not win. This role owns that sheet.
 



 This is a domain\-first estimation role, not a generalist bid\-coordination or proposal\-writing role. We are looking for someone who has worked inside utility metering, billing or AMI projects, can read an RFP the way a delivery head reads it, and can independently produce a complete, defensible cost workbook that leadership can price from with confidence.
 



  





**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 Own the translation of utility RFPs/tenders into:
 



**(a)** 
 a clear, itemised list of what BCITS must deliver
 



**(b)** 
 a complete internal Excel cost model covering every component and expenditure BCITS will incur across the full contract term with no omissions, no double\-counting and no padding.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. RFP / Tender Comprehension
 


* Read the entire tender pack scope of work, technical specifications, SLAs, payment terms, GCC/SCC, annexures, corrigenda and pre\-bid clarifications and extract precisely what BCITS is obligated to deliver, supply, install, integrate, operate and maintain, and for how long.
* Distinguish explicit deliverables from implied ones (e.g., a data\-migration obligation hidden in an integration clause, a training obligation inside a go\-live milestone, a DR requirement inside an uptime SLA).
* Identify eligibility, compliance and technical conditions that affect cost or bid fit (certifications, MeitY cloud, BIS/IS standards, local\-content rules, consortium terms).
* Flag ambiguities, contradictions and scope gaps and draft pre\-bid queries whose answers directly change the cost model.



 2\. Deliverable Mapping
 


* Prepare a Deliverable Breakdown Structure for each bid: every item BCITS must deliver, the quantity, the specification, the phase/milestone in which it falls and the acceptance condition.
* Validate the breakdown with delivery, solution and O\&M leads so that nothing in the RFP is left unowned internally.



 3\. Internal Cost Estimation (core accountability)
 


* Build the internal cost workbook in Excel for each bid, itemised across the cost heads listed below, with quantities, unit rates, sources of rates, assumptions and the calculation logic visible and auditable.
* Model costs across the full contract life implementation, warranty, O\&M/AMC including escalation, replacement cycles, SLA penalty exposure and cash\-flow impact of milestone\-linked payments.
* Obtain and validate rates from OEMs, telecom/communication partners, cloud providers, subcontractors and internal delivery teams; maintain a current rate library so estimates are not built from stale figures.
* Run sensitivity and scenario views (consumer count, read frequency, hosting model, manpower mix) so leadership can see where the estimate is most exposed.
* Present the cost sheet to the CEO and bid committee with a clear statement of assumptions, risks and confidence level; support margin and pricing decisions with facts, not opinions.



 4\. Bid Support
 


* Attend pre\-bid meetings and site visits; capture clarifications and corrigenda and reflect their cost impact immediately in the workbook.
* Support commercial bid preparation (BOQ/price schedule) so that the submitted price schedule reconciles exactly with the internal cost model.
* Support post\-submission clarifications, negotiations and reverse\-auction rounds with a clear view of the floor price.



 5\. Estimation Discipline \& Learning Loop
 


* Maintain a standard cost\-sheet template and estimation checklist for AMI/metering/billing bids and improve it after every bid.
* Compare estimated vs actual cost on won projects with delivery and finance teams; feed variances back into the template and rate library.
* Maintain a tender tracker with bid outcomes, L1 pricing intelligence and win/loss reasons.



  





**COST HEADS THE ROLE MUST COVER** 




 The candidate should be able to identify, size and price the following from an RFP without being prompted:
 



**Software \& Licences** 




 HES, MDM/MDAS, billing/CIS, CRM, GIS, prepaid, analytics, mobile apps; third\-party licences (DB, OS, middleware, cloud); customisation and integration effort with utility legacy systems.
 



**Hardware \& Field Devices** 




 Meters, communication modules, DCUs/gateways/RF concentrators, network equipment; spares, DOA/warranty replacement, testing and lab charges.
 



**Communication \& Connectivity** 




 RF mesh / RF\-PLC / NB\-IoT / cellular; SIM and data charges over contract life; telecom partner terms.
 



**Infrastructure \& Hosting** 




 Data centre / cloud (on\-prem vs MeitY\-empanelled cloud), DR, sizing for consumer count and read frequency, bandwidth, security compliance, escalation over term.
 



**Manpower** 




 Project management, solution and integration teams, field survey, installation and commissioning crews, helpdesk, O\&M staff — by role, location, duration and rate, including deployment ramp\-up/ramp\-down.
 



**Installation \& Commissioning** 




 Site survey, meter installation and replacement, testing, consumer indexing, data migration, UAT, go\-live support, training.
 



**O\&M / AMC / FMS** 




 Multi\-year operations, SLA\-linked penalties and liquidated damages, annual price escalation, obsolescence and technology refresh.
 



**Commercial \& Compliance** 




 EMD, PBG/security deposit cost, insurance, taxes/GST treatment, payment\-milestone cash flow and working\-capital cost, retention money, price\-variation clauses.
 



**Risk \& Contingency** 




 Quantified contingency for scope ambiguity, exchange rate, delayed site readiness, AMISP/SI consortium dependencies and change\-request exposure.
 



  





**MUST\-HAVE REQUIREMENTS** 



* **Domain** 
 Hands\-on utility domain experience: 6–12 years in the power/water/gas utility sector in AMI, smart metering, MDAS/MDM, billing/revenue management or metering\-communication projects in a delivery, solution, project\-management, estimation or presales capacity. Candidates without direct utility\-domain exposure will not be considered.
* **RFP literacy** 
 Has read and worked from utility RFPs/tenders (DISCOM, AMISP, SI/EPC, RDSS, R\-APDRP, IPDS, SMNP) and can explain scope, SLAs, payment milestones and penalty clauses in operational terms.
* **Costing track record** 
 Has personally built or owned bottom\-up cost estimates / BOQs for multi\-component technology projects with software, hardware, manpower and multi\-year O\&M elements; can show a sample or walk through one in interview.
* **Excel** 
 Advanced Excel structured, auditable workbooks with clear assumptions, lookups, scenario tabs and reconciliation checks. This is the primary working tool of the role.
* **Delivery realism** 
 Understands the practical cost drivers of an AMI/metering rollout where projects overrun (site readiness, communication coverage, consumer indexing, integration with legacy billing, O\&M manpower) and how those translate to money.
* **Attention to detail** 
 Demonstrated habit of checking work line by line, reconciling totals and questioning numbers that look wrong. Comfortable being accountable for the accuracy of the estimate.
* **Education** 
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / Computer Science) or equivalent.



  





**GOOD TO HAVE** 



* MBA (Finance/Operations) or formal exposure to project costing, cost accounting or financial modelling.
* Working relationships with meter OEMs, communication technology providers, cloud/hosting partners or AMISPs.
* Exposure to public procurement norms GeM, e\-tendering portals, EMD/PBG, L1/QCBS evaluation, reverse auctions.
* Experience reconciling estimated vs actual project costs post\-award.



  





**HOW WE WILL ASSESS CANDIDATES** 




 Shortlisted candidates will be given an extract from a real utility RFP and asked to
 



 (1\) list the deliverables,
 



 (2\) build a cost sheet in Excel
 



 (3\) present their assumptions and identify what they would raise as pre\-bid queries. Selection will be based on completeness, domain judgement and clarity of the workbook not presentation polish.
 



  





**KEY COMPETENCIES** 



* Utility domain depth (AMI, metering, billing, revenue management)
* Analytical rigor and numerical accuracy
* Ownership and accountability for outcomes
* Structured, auditable working style
* Clear communication of assumptions and risks to leadership

title: Founder's Office - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Founder's Office \- Strategy \& Operations** 





 LH2 AI Labs · Bengaluru · Full\-time · On\-site 
 




  





**Mandatory requirement: a bachelor's degree from a premier engineering institute such as IIT, BITS, or NIT, or an MBA from a leading business school such as IIM, ISB, XLRI, or an equivalent institution.** 




  





**About** 





 Built by second\-time founders who have built and sold companies before, LH2 AI Labs (lh2\.ai) is building the post\-training infrastructure for frontier AI models.
 





 We bring private, high\-quality institutional datasets and vetted domain experts to frontier AI pipelines across verticals like coding, computer use, agentic, medical, audio and more.
 





 For AI to keep progressing, it needs high\-quality training data drawn from real production use cases. The public web has already been crawled and trained on – there's nothing left there. That's where we come in: we envision creating a world where frontier models can access data on tap – exactly how they access compute today.
 




  





**The role** 





 We're looking for smart people to lead our revenue function – i.e., our data verticals – coding, finance, company operations, medical, audio, egocentric, and many upcoming verticals.
 





 Leading a vertical means an ownership mindset and owning the entire revenue stack:
 



* Working with frontier models to understand training data requirements
* Finding the right data owners
* Negotiating licensing rights and closing agreements
* Building the delivery data pipelines with our engineering team
* Ensuring seamless delivery




 This is not a role where you'll be making decks or Excel sheets. It's a carry\-a\-number, close\-the\-deal role that happens to sit right next to the founders.
 





 Here's how it works. We point you at a vertical – codebases, medical, audio, whatever's next – and you go build its supply from scratch. You figure out who in the world has the data and expertise we need, work out how to win them, and close them. You own the whole thing: who to approach, in what order, on what terms, and where the moat gets built. Each vertical runs like its own small business, and what you learn in the field shapes what the founders prioritise next.
 





 We can teach you the domain, the data, and the AI landscape. We can't teach you to think on your feet or to want closure. That part you bring.
 




  





**What we're looking for** 



* You can sell. 2\-5 years in sales, partnerships, or BD with a real sales cycle – ideally opening and building new relationships from scratch (new business / new logo, not just managing an existing book). You've carried a number and owned deals end to end.
* Genuinely sharp. Top\-tier education and/or time at well\-regarded companies – you've operated around a high bar, and it shows. You pick things up fast, and you can hold your own in a room.
* Consultative problem\-solver – you read what a counterpart needs, solve the problem in front of you, and build a deal around it.
* Think like an owner – comfortable shaping how your vertical goes to market, not just executing a plan handed to you.
* Comfortable negotiating bespoke, non\-standard terms.
* Sharp on quality: you can tell what's worth closing and what isn't.
* High ownership; thrive in fast, ambiguous environments.
* A generalist who has worked in startups before – hands\-on with tools, automation, and basic scripting, and comfortable figuring things out without a playbook.



  





**Bonus** 



* Prior experience in a programme management role.
* Opened new markets, categories, or accounts from cold – where the relationship didn't exist before you walked in.
* A track record of running many deals at once, against a target, without hand\-holding.
* Sold into small buying committees (fewer than five stakeholders) and know how to move them.
* Prior exposure to AI, data, expert networks, or marketplaces.
* Founder's office, consulting, banking, or operating roles at a high\-growth B2B company.

title: Industrial Applications Engineer – Energy & Decarbonization
description:
**About the Company** 




 Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid\-flow technology, with over 1400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet. As a member of our team, you’ll dive into an environment that encourages learning and boundary\-pushing every day. You’ll be part of an agile and dynamic workplace where today’s solutions are built for tomorrow’s challenges.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Industrial Applications Engineer – Energy \& Decarbonization is a globally\-scoped, customer\-facing technical role that can be based in India, UK, or China. The role serves Armstrong’s Industrial business across Metals, Mining, Cement, Food \& Beverage, and other power and water\-intensive industries. This role is the founding layer of Armstrong’s Industrial Regional Sales Enablement Centre (RSEC) function. The person in this position receives strategic direction from the Global Product Manager, translates it into commercial and technical enablement for regional sales teams, and feeds ground\-level customer and market intelligence back to shape how that strategy evolves. The core technical mandate is built on four pillars: Heating, Cooling, Water Transfer, and High\-Pressure Applications – covering descaling, high pressure washing and cleaning, and high\-pressure fluid supply systems for hydraulic press operations. The primary mission is simple but demanding ensure that every industrial offer submitted is technically sound and commercially compelling, and that Armstrong’s value proposition is consistently understood and communicated by the regional sales teams that carry it to market.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Offer Creation \& Technical Quality** 



* This is the primary accountability of the role. The Industrial Applications Engineer owns the creation and quality of every technical offer submitted in the industrial segment.
* Own the end\-to\-end creation of technical offers for industrial customers across Metals, Mining, Cement, Food \& Beverage, and other power and water\-intensive sectors.
* Ensure every offer is technically accurate, application\-appropriate, and clearly communicates the Armstrong value proposition in language that resonates with industrial plant\-level stakeholders.
* Select and specify the right solution architecture across Heating, Cooling, Water Transfer, and High\-Pressure Applications based on customer process requirements.
* Build energy savings calculations, ROI models, and lifecycle cost cases from first principles as the commercial backbone of each offer.
* Conduct detailed P\&ID analysis for each customer engagement – mapping every heating, cooling, water transfer, and high\-pressure touchpoint to identify the full Armstrong addressable scope and ensure offers reflect the complete opportunity, not just the immediate enquiry.
* Ensure offers reflect industrial environment requirements including protection classes, IP ratings, and hazardous area classifications appropriate to the application.
* Review and validate offers prepared by the regional sales team before submission, maintaining a consistent technical and commercial quality standard across all industrial proposals.



  





**Customer Technical Engagement** 



* The Industrial Applications Engineer is the technical authority in customer\-facing industrial conversations, supporting and enabling the regional sales teams who own the customer relationship.
* Engage directly with plant engineers, process managers, and energy managers at customer facilities to understand process requirements, pain points, and optimization opportunities.
* Conduct site assessments and process audits to map Heating, Cooling, Water Transfer, and High\-Pressure system architectures and identify where Armstrong solutions deliver value.
* Analyse P\&IDs as a commercial tool – identifying every relevant application touchpoint across the plant to build a structured opportunity map that maximises Armstrong wallet share at each account.
* Deliver technically credible presentations and solution walkthroughs that translate complex fluid\-flow and thermal management concepts into clear operational and financial outcomes for the customer.
* Support customers in understanding how Armstrong solutions meet industrial environment requirements, protection class standards, and process\-specific compliance needs.



  





**Industrial Strategy Propagation \& Sales Enablement** 



* A core responsibility of this role is to ensure that Armstrong’s industrial strategy is understood, adopted, and consistently executed by regional sales teams – preventing the default tendency to revert to commodity product selling.
* Receive and internalise Armstrong’s industrial strategy from the Global Product Manager and translate it into actionable guidance, tools, and training for regional sales teams.
* Train regional sales teams on Armstrong’s industrial offer, application scope, value proposition, energy savings methodology, ROI narrative, and decarbonization positioning.
* Develop and maintain repeatable sales enablement tools – application guides, value proposition frameworks, calculation templates, and reference case studies – that raise the technical floor of commercial teams globally.
* Actively participate in regional weekly sales reviews, contributing industrial application expertise, offer quality oversight, and strategic direction to ensure industrial opportunities are being pursued with the right solution and the right narrative.
* Monitor CRM pipeline in collaboration with sales to ensure industrial opportunities are properly qualified, accurately described, and progressing with the correct Armstrong solution – flagging where commodity positioning is replacing solution selling.
* Feed ground\-level market and customer intelligence back to the Global Product Manager to continuously refine and sharpen Armstrong’s industrial strategy based on real commercial experience.



  





**High Pressure Applications** 



* High Pressure Applications represent a distinct and technically demanding segment within Armstrong’s industrial portfolio. The Industrial Applications Engineer is the subject matter authority for this space.
* Define and deliver application solutions for high pressure fluid supply systems powering hydraulic press circuits in metals and heavy manufacturing environments.
* Develop application expertise in high pressure descaling systems – including billet, slab, and strip mill descaling in steel and aluminium production.
* Build competency in high pressure washing and cleaning system applications for industrial and hygiene\-critical environments including Food \& Beverage.
* Advise on system design, pressure management, equipment selection, and safety considerations for high pressure circuits operating in industrial protection class environments.
* Ensure high pressure application requirements are accurately captured and specified in customer offers.



  





**Energy Optimization \& Decarbonization Positioning** 



* Energy savings and decarbonization are the strategic lens through which Armstrong’s industrial value proposition is delivered – not a separate workstream, but the narrative frame applied across all customer and sales engagements.
* Quantify energy savings and carbon reduction potential of Armstrong

title: Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ327R286
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect part of a the Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI\-forward SaaS customers operating globally. In this role, you will be deeply embedded with our named strategic accounts, serving as a trusted long\-term technical advisor while also collaborating with internal sales, product, and engineering teams.
   

  

 You will help our customers achieve tangible data\-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.
   

  

 Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
   

  

**The impact you will have**
* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
* Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build\-vs\-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on Databricks.
* Partner with the sales team and provide hands\-on technical leadership to help large enterprise customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems across the full data and AI lifecycle.
* Consult on modern Lakehouse architectures and implement proofs of concept for strategic projects spanning data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, GenAI— including validating integrations with cloud services, in\-house tools, and third\-party applications.
* Work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Collaborate across regions with fellow Solutions Architects and account teams, supporting our customers with consistent architectural guidance across their international footprint.
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks\-inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) across the developer community.


**What We Look For**
* 12\+ years in data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or a similar pre\-sales / consulting role.
* 8\+ years hands\-on experience with Big Data and AI technologies, including Apache Spark™, data engineering, data science, and modern AI/ML workloads.
* Strong hands\-on architectural experience — able to whiteboard, design, and personally build end\-to\-end solutions, not just advise.
* Demonstrated experience working with large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers; experience supporting global accounts across multiple geographies strongly preferred.
* Experience working with digital\-native or SaaS enterprises with mature data and AI practices is a strong plus.
* Strong consulting / customer\-facing experience working with external clients across a variety of industries.
* Coding experience in Python, SQL, Scala, Java, or R.
* Experience building distributed data systems at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Available to travel to customers in your region and occasionally internationally.
* Nice to have: prior experience working in or with a Global Capability Center model; Databricks Certification.


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
   

  

**Benefits**

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud\-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
   

  

**What is The Role:**
 We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
 **Consulting Architect** 
 to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands\-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
   

  

 You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value\-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior\-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on\-site client engagement.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing:**
 As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on\-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end\-to\-end delivery of ground\-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof\-of\-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
   

  

 Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
   

  

 Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
   

  

**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**
* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7\+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine\-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Hands\-on experience with on\-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands\-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship\-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.
* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.


**Bonus Points:**
* Familiarity/Experience in implementing similar products in Search Domain (Solr, Algolia, Open Search)
* Any cloud service provider's \- Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications (e.g., Elastic Certified Analyst, Specializations) and/or specialization in machine learning, data analytics.
* Experience working closely with a pre\-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.

 As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. title: Lead - Managed Services Consultant
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What Are Your Responsibilities**
* Ensure that every customer derives the most value possible from the platform leading to retention and business expansion.
* Identify, comprehend and clearly articulate customers' requirements to generate an end\-to\-end solution to their business challenges.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and tie them to specific Sprinklr use cases, product features, benefits and value propositions.
* Identify platform gaps, and optimization opportunities; designing and configuring the appropriate solutions so client expectations regarding platform use\-cases and functionalities are fulfilled.
* Own \& deliver the end\-to\-end configuration of solution based on the customer requirements
* You will handle the post go\-live change management of configuration throughout the customer life cycle
* Be the hands\-on product expert and ensure customer’s business goals are met
* Act as day\-to\-day contact for stakeholders in brand, agencies and for System Administrators.
* Analyse and elevate customer’s consumption of contract, adoption of the product and generation of upsell or cross\-sell.
* Provide oversight on any additional enablement of the software deployment to be in line with current architecture and future client needs or business requirements.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve operational efficiencies and find suitable entities which could benefit from utilising AI to drive greater ROI.
* Establish and nurture senior level relationships built on trust, develop client champions and identify key stakeholders.
* Capture development areas for product improvement and collaborate with product managers and engineering for necessary corrective actions.
* Actively make sure you are knowledgeable on native channel’s products package.
* Work with clients to improve the social service itself and its alignment with the client's core business.
* Provide on\-going training support and ad hoc training sessions to always keep customers educated on Sprinklr’s know\-hows.
* Identify opportunities for customer references and case studies.
* Maintain platform relevancy according to changes in business needs.


- 

**Who You Are \& What Makes You Qualified**

title: Consultant II
description:
**Role Description**
 Role Proficiency:
   

  

 Consultant working with stakeholders at every level of the organization soliciting strategic imperatives from senior leaders and executives; supporting business unit managers as they leverage business architecture and product development artifacts to create and implement client business plans
   

  

**Outcomes**
* Works with stakeholders at every level of the organization soliciting strategic imperatives from senior leaders and executives; supporting business unit managers as they leverage business architecture and product development artifacts to create and implement client business plans.
* Provide direct input into the governance cycle that supports the achievement of key goals planning and execution of various scenarios and delivery of bottom line value to the business
* Help client business and leadership team with problem definition
* Lead business and technology consulting projects to deliver client objectives
* Perform assessments of client business processes organizational change IT processes and technology landscape; identifying transformational recommendations
* Develop a business and technical architecture strategy based on situational awareness of various business scenarios and motivations.
* Apply a structured business architecture approach and methodology for capturing key views of the enterprise.
* Guide a team to capture the tactical and strategic enterprise goals that provide traceability through the organization; and are mapped to metrics that provide ongoing governance.
* Guide a team to describe the primary business functions of the enterprise and distinguish between customer\-facing supplier\-related business execution and business management functions.
* Guide a team to define the set of strategic core and support processes that transcend functional and organizational boundaries; identify and describe external entities such as customers suppliers and external systems that interact with the business. Identify which people resources and controls are involved in the processes.
* Guide a team to define the data shared across the enterprise and the relationships between the data.
* Guide a team to capture the relationships among roles capabilities and business units the decomposition of those business units into subunits and the internal or external management of those units.


**Measures Of Outcomes**
* Transformational value delivered to customer
* Utilization in billable roles
* Customer feedback
* Number of certifications obtained
* Number of reusable components designed for CoEs


**Outputs Expected**
 Design and Implementation Support:
   

  

* Understand the business requirements from the analyst and create a mapping document if required (specific to integration)
* Evaluate technical requirements (e.g. number of interfaces required maps required for each interface etc.); understand the design concepts to be used
* Study the best practices for design and jointly design the solution; review the design for potential flaws; verify the design with CoE


**Practice Development**
* Provide feedback on current gaps with internal processes that can be improved


**Knowledge Management**
* Identify best practices tools and solution accelerators for products in the solution area; bring in the existing solution accelerators reusable assets etc.
* Review the solutions and identify opportunity to create reusable assets solution accelerators etc.
* Stay up to date with new developments in the product and technology solution area under purview
* Analyze the best in class solutions and design aspects track industry trends and draw insights


**Solution Development**
* Build understanding of new solutions and develop delivery capability
* Assist in creation of new solutions by providing inputs and insights


**Product Selection**
* Collaborate with the product selection group to identify the best suited product to meet the project requirements; provide inputs on product features as required


**Technology Consulting Advisory**
* Engage with client stakeholders during advisory engagements
* Gather information relevant to the client's context and conduct detailed analysis using technology solution frameworks
* Lead consulting team to deliver to client’s expectations
* Seek guidance from Consulting Manager as required
* Arrive at draft recommendations based on analysis
* Provide thought leadership on implementation of specific technology
* Engage with client stakeholders


**Alliance Management**
* Engage with the technology specialists of the product vendor to identify ways to leverage the product


**Skill Examples**
* Uses Domain / Industry knowledge to contextualize the solution to the industry assess the domain specific risks to the solution review the business requirements captured and assess the gap. P in business requirement workshops to generate ideas w.r.t domain specific KPIs reporting requirements etc.
* Use COTS Product Features / Functionality knowledge to understand the technical/functional dependencies of the product work flow/custom component (native and outside product). Independently analyze the customizations completed and required to the base product applying the best practices in her/her own area of work. Impart training on the various functional modules of the product or custom components/solutions provided configure or change a module/change custom code in the product independently
* Uses Competitive Products Landscape knowledge to relate how the same business events are handled in different products; leverage reusable solutions across products
* Uses Different Implementations knowledge to relate own area of work to the big picture of the project. Expand the approach for the specific functionality and highlight potential gaps and risks as necessary
* Uses Technology Concepts knowledge to identify technical risk and define mitigation strategies during coding. Validate review and make recommendation to complex queries recommending appropriate framework approach solution to meet the functional and non functional requirements and create HLD for the project. Guide junior team members in creating the LLD create POC to validate new tools and solutions compare and contrast technology landscape options for the customer identify and leverage the most appropriate tools to set up the build environment build training materials and assessments for technologies conduct project training and assist in ramp up
* Uses specialized knowledge of process consulting to drive changes in customer organization. Conduct workshops independently lead a consulting engagement play the role of a trusted advisor within UST and with clients on process harmonization converting leads to opportunities and coach team members
* Uses Project Management Tools and Techniques knowledge to plan and manage simple small or medium size projects/ modules as defined within UST. Identify risks and mitigation strategies and implement the same to manage simple small or medium size projects/ modules identify critical path and manage dependencies within a small project
* Uses Project Governance Framework knowledge to create / customize RACI matrix and governance framework for small or medium size projects. Support development of the communication protocols establish and follow an escalation matrix for small or medium size projects create reporting mechanisms for small / medium projects/ modules as defined within UST
* Uses Project Metrics knowledge to understand relevance in project collect and collate project metrics and share it with the relevant stakeholders; understand and apply the tools used to track metrics
* Uses Estimation and Resource Planning knowledge to create estimate and plan resources for specific modules / small projects with detailed requirements in place. Conduct impact analysis for changes and analyze corresponding impact to overall estimates resource loading and MPP (re\-baseline)
* Uses Requirement Gathering and Analysis knowledge to raise ambiguities on requirements shared create requirement management artifacts (such as traceability matrix etc.) provide inputs/ create estimates and solutions (based on the size of the project. Identify impacted areas based on the change requests understand the data and model based on requirements create/review design artifacts apply common requirements repository in context of project/program
* Uses Solution Structuring knowledge to create customized solution to the problem and present the proposed solution to customer; highlighting the solution benefits and road map to achieve. Carve out simple solution / POC to build confidence in the solution review the proposal for completeness
* Uses Knowledge Management Tools \& Techniques knowledge to leverage existing material/ re\-usable assets and enhance in knowledge repository. Independently create and update knowledge artifacts perform skill gap analysis create and track project specific KT plans provide training to others write white papers/ blogs at internal level (if applicable). Write technical documents/ user understanding documents at the end of the project implement KM and KT measurement metrics
* Uses Technical Standards Documentation \& Templates knowledge to create documentation appropriate for the project. Create documentation appropriate for the reusable assets/ best practices/ case studies apply tools and processes that can track compliance to defined technical standards at the project level
* Uses Pricing \& Licensing Models knowledge to conduct pricing exercise for complex projects viz. FP / value\-based pricing etc. understand pricing strategies and business models of relevant products solutions or associated services review medium\-complex proposals

+ Solution Structuring: Demonstrates working knowledge of UST service offering domain related COTS products. Basic knowledge of service lines in UST
+ Knowledge Management Tools \& Techniques: Demonstrates working knowledge of industry knowledge management tools (such as portals wiki) UST and customer knowledge management tools techniques (such as classroom training self\-study application walkthrough and reverse KT)
+ Technical Standards Documentation \& Templates: Demonstrates working knowledge of various document templates and standards (such as business blueprint design documents and test specifications)
+ Pricing \& Licensing Models: Working knowledge of pricing models (fixed price non\-linear and united )
+ End User License Agreements etc) Awareness of advanced commercial and pricing models (outcome\-based transactional pricing non\-linear)

 Customer meeting(s) and customer cadence calls

 Diverse Experiences

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

description:

**"UCAM manufactures world\-class rotary tables and precision machine tools trusted by aerospace, defense, and automotive customers globally. Join a team of engineers and technicians who build things that matter with precision, at scale, from Bangalore".**
**Why Build Your Career at UCAM**
* Global Footprint, Indian Pride: Work on proprietary, high\-precision engineering products designed and manufactured right here in Bangalore and exported worldwide.
* A Culture of Mastery: Surround yourself with brilliant technical minds who thrive on solving complex mechanical, kinematic, and structural puzzles.
* The Blueprint for Growth: Get hands\-on experience in a highly sophisticated manufacturing environment, working with advanced CNC technologies and rigorous quality standards.
* Comprehensive Stability: We support our builders with robust health insurance, secure PF benefits, and reliable transport/commute facilities across our strategic hubs.


**Job Description**
**Academic Background: Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering**
**Preferred Industry : Gear Cutting Machine tool industry**
**Work Experience: 2 to 4 years**
**Main Task**
 Customer Support:
   

  

* Providing pre\-sales technical support, including feasibility studies and presentations to customers.
* Offering post\-sales support, including training,troubleshooting, and resolving process\-related issues at customer sites.
* Conducting machine commissioning and ensuring optimal performance.


**Application Development**
* Developing and optimising applications for existing machines.
* Assisting in the development of new gear cutting machine products.
* Conducting component trials and prove\-outs.


**Technical Expertise**
* Analysing engineering drawings, electrical schematics, and manufacturing processes related to gear cutting.
* Understanding customer requirements and translating them into machine configurations and process parameters.
* Providing technical documentation like offers, control plans, and cycle time studies.


**Collaboration And Communication**
* Collaborating with sales and product development teams to address customer needs and provide feedback.
* Maintaining clear communication with customers to address queries and provide solutions.
* Representing the company at exhibitions and industry events.


**Competencies Required**
 Gear Manufacturing Process Knowledge:
   

  

* Understanding of various gear types (spur, helical,bevel, etc.), gear cutting methods (hobbing, shaping,grinding, etc.), and the associated tooling, fixtures,and setup procedures.


**Machine Operation And Setup**
* Familiarity with operating and setting up gear cutting machines, including CNC controls (Fanuc, Siemens,etc.).


**CNC Programming**

title: Associate, Startup Accounts
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**The Role** 
**: Associate,** 
**Startup Accounts Farming**
 To sustain and nurture solid relationships with key clients that generate the most income for Razorpay.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Building and maintaining relationships with clients and key personnel within their company.
* Cross\-selling and Up\-selling to the client base and growing the account to achieve the portfolio quota.
* Conducting business reviews to ensure clients are satisfied with their products and services.
* Attending meetings with clients inside and outside their offices to build better relationships with them.
* Achieving client relationship targets and KPI’s as set by the team lead.
* Liaising with internal departments to ensure client needs are fulfilled effectively.
* Escalating and resolving areas of concern as raised by clients.
* Carrying out client satisfaction surveys and reviews.
* Monitoring company performance against service level agreements and flagging potential issues. Updating the CRM for any change with regard to a client.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* Relevant experience in Key Account Management/Sales in the B2B space.
* Knowledge of best customer service practices.
* Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to build rapport with customers.
* Go\-getter attitude.
* Hardworking with a strong work ethic.


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn \& Twitter

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Partnership Management** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 2\+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

**Required Skills:**
* 10\-15 years of experience in OT, ICS, industrial cybersecurity, or a related field, including experience leading teams and engagements.

* Experience in Power and Utilities, Oil and Gas, Manufacturing, or Industrial Products.

Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people.  At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization.
