title: Manager - Product and Growth
description:
Location: Mumbai / Bengaluru only
   

  

 Type: Full\-time \| Reports to: Founder / VP Product GTM \| Start: Immediate
   

  

**ANY APPLICATIONS WITHOUT THE PREREQUISITE DELIVERABLES MENTIONED IN THE “HOW TO APPLY” SECTION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.**
**About CredServ**
 CredServ is building the operating layer for financial relationships between businesses — an AI\-native platform built for how companies trade, monitor exposure, collect cash, and reconcile.
   

  

**Live Products Today**
* CredCheck — who to do business with, how much exposure to take, how to monitor the relationship.
* CredCollect — an AI conversation agent that follows up on invoices and gets businesses paid faster, with a human in the loop.


 Downstream: CredRecon. The long game is a global business\-relationship graph. Every customer is a node. Every distributor, dealer, and invoice is an edge.
   

  

 We acquire three compounding cohorts: corporates who sell through dealers; SMB / MSME distributors and dealers; and independent last\-mile businesses who collect from customers. Each cohort has a different product surface. Mixing them is how conversion dies. Read more about what we do: credserv.ai
   

  

**The role**
 We need an execution\-first Product GTM Manager who will own revenue quality and unit economics from week one — and who treats AI agents as staff, not as a slide topic.
   

  

 This is not a brand job. This is not a ‘give me a performance\-marketing budget and a team’ job. Paid social already exists for SMB and micro\-business acquisition. Corporate acquisitions are named\-account work, LinkedIn, and live working sessions. A Grok agent desk already drafts research, iteration, and execution. You will run that desk, sit with customers, force the smallest product changes that move conversion, and be accountable for rupees in versus rupees out.
   

  

 If your instinct is to scale spend before activation is understood, this seat will feel underpowered. That is intentional.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* A weekly number: corporate pilots closed, SMB/distributor organisations that reach a first value event, and last\-mile users who collect a first rupee — not pipeline coverage or MQL volume.
* Unit economics by cohort: cost to a working session (corporate), cost to activation (SMB), cost to first reminder and first collection (micro). Floors are published. Breaching them to buy volume is a miss.
* The daily loop: execute → measure → kill what does not work → specify a product micro\-fix → ship → execute again.
* Corporate motion: named accounts, insight\-led LinkedIn, 20\-minute working sessions (hear the agent on real overdue rows), 14\-day DSO\-sprint pilots, and invites that pull the corporate’s dealers onto CredServ.
* SMB and micro motion: hold existing Instagram / Facebook / YouTube / WhatsApp and on\-ground UGC / affiliate channels to activation and cash — reallocate every day. Do not ‘run the campaign’.
* Direct the existing AI agents (research, iteration, execution). Improve their prompts and playbooks. Do not replace them with a meeting culture.
* Write one\-page product patch specs (example: GSTIN\-first signup, WhatsApp three\-name collect list, shareable agent recording, dealer\-invite claim). Sit with engineering until the patch is live.
* A daily numbers note and a weekly review. Short. No committee decks.


**What You Will Not Own**
* A blank media cheque or a six\-person demand\-gen org in quarter one.
* Making paid social the primary way we reach CFOs.
* Brand campaigns, generic webinars, or ‘category design’ as the job.
* A 90\-day listening tour before touching a customer.


**What This Looks Like In 90 Days**
* You have personally run corporate working sessions and taken at least one pilot to a convert\-or\-kill decision, with dealer invites actually sent.
* SMB activation and first\-value\-event rates have moved because a step was deleted or a journey was tightened — not only because more ads were bought.
* At least one product change you specified is live and visible in conversion.
* Unit\-economic floors have held for four straight weeks, or you have formally changed a floor with evidence.
* You can run the daily desk — including the AI agents — without the founder in the room.


**Who This Is For**
 You have carried a number in a messy B2B motion — credit, collections, channel / distribution software, ERP\-adjacent products, invoice / trade finance, MSME infrastructure — and you can open the spreadsheet, not just the narrative.
   

  

**You Have Done Some Mix Of The Following**
* Taken a motion from founder\-led selling to a thin, repeatable machine.
* Improved a funnel by removing steps, not by buying more traffic.
* Sat across the table from a CFO or a proprietor, heard no, and still closed or cleanly killed.
* Used AI agents as colleagues this month — concrete workflows, not ‘we are exploring GenAI’.
* Worked India: English and Hindi. A regional language is an advantage. You will travel for customer dinners and shop\-floor / godown conversations.


 You do not need to have run a 50\-person growth team. You do need to have been responsible when the week missed.
   

  

**Who This Is Not For**
* Operators who are not working in an AI native work environment.
* Operators who do not delegate \>50% of their BAU to AI agents.
* Marketers whose primary proof is ‘we scaled spend 10x’.
* Strategy consultants who have never owned a revenue target after leaving the firm.
* Operators who need a large team and a media tranche before they will touch a customer.
* People who treat WhatsApp\-led or last\-mile motions as beneath them.


**How To Apply**
 Send a short note (one page, not a manifesto) to vivek.kothari@credserv.in, or apply through the board, with the following:
   

  

* A motion you owned where spends went down and revenue quality went up. What did you cut?
* CAC / payback on that motion, and one metric you refused to optimise.
* How you use AI in your work this month — tools, prompts, or agents, not a point of view.
* What you would do in week one at CredServ with no new paid\-media budget, across a corporate buyer and a WhatsApp\-led SMB buyer.


 The subject title of your email must contain
 **\[PRODUCT GTM MANAGER – CSJR0025]** 
 .
   

  

**ANY APPLICATIONS WITHOUT THE ABOVE PREREQUISITE DELIVERABLES WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.**
 Do not apply if you do not work in a native AI environment / are not at a stage where you delegate \>50% of your BAU to AI. This is a high performance role that requires you to leverage AI to its fullest potential.
   

  

 Candidates who progress will complete a six\-hour case before any offer. We hire on the work, not on the performance of the interview.
   

  

*CredServ is an equal\-opportunity employer. We care that you can run the desk.*

**FICO (NYSE: FICO)** 
 is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100\+ countries make better decisions. Join our world\-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Customer Engineer is our entry point into technical customer success — a hands\-on executor who learns by doing, builds foundational platform knowledge, and contributes to reliable, well\-documented customer solutions. This role works in structured environments under clear guidance, following patterns set by more senior roles. Success here is about learning deeply, executing reliably, and building the habits of quality and repeatability that define great Customer Engineers at every level.
   

  

**What You'll Contribute**
* Analyze recurring and complex customer\-impacting engineering issues and identify opportunities for AI\-driven automation.
* Build AI\-powered tools and workflows that help engineers diagnose, troubleshoot, remediate, and prevent customer issues.
* Develop prompt harnesses and evaluation frameworks to systematically test LLM solutions against real\-world engineering scenarios.
* Work with code, logs, configurations, documentation, tickets, incidents, and other engineering context to build grounded AI solutions.
* Design agentic workflows where LLMs can reason over context, use tools, perform actions, validate results, and iterate.
* Understand and optimize the complete LLM loop: Context → Prompt → Model → Tool → Observation → Validation → Iteration
* Investigate AI failures methodically and improve prompts, context, tools, model selection, and workflows.
* Build prototypes quickly and turn successful experiments into reliable, reusable engineering capabilities.
* Develop automation that can identify patterns across customer issues and surface potential root causes or recommended actions.
* Measure solutions using meaningful engineering metrics such as accuracy, resolution time, automation rate, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Partner with internal engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing tools and workflows.
* Help establish reusable patterns for applying AI to customer engineering problems at scale.


**What We're Seeking**
* Early\-career experience in a technical implementation or customer\-facing role, with a demonstrated ability to translate well\-defined requirements into concrete technical tasks across configuration, integration, and deployment scenarios.
* 4\+ years of experience
* Experience in LLM Application Development: Hands\-on experience building production applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and function/tool calling.
* Experience in AI Agents \& Orchestration: Experience building agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent, including MCP/tool integrations.
* Experience in Production AI Engineering: Strong Python/software engineering skills with experience deploying, monitoring, evaluating, and optimizing AI workloads for reliability, latency, cost, and security

You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

title: Applications Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Change the world. Love your job.**
 Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.
   

  

 Our business has very high growth in TI and is in a segment where the market is fast growing. We are looking for an application engineer who has the passion and excitement to grow, innovate, take an active role in solving controller \& Power stage technical challenges, create novel reference material for various CPU/ASIC power solutions, provide top\-notch applications support to customers for various applications, defining next Gen multiphase controller \& Power stage for Enterprise Computing/Datacenter market. This is a fast paced, results driven environment that requires broad knowledge, creativity and excellent interpersonal skills on a daily basis. They then collaborate with the full IC development team (design, test, product engineers) to deliver products to the market which are compelling, competitive, cost\-conscious, manufacturable, and importantly, successful in growing TI's business
   

  

 In this role, you will be part of a strong and fast\-moving team with opportunities to:
   

  

* Design and build evaluation modules for Multiphase Controller \& Power stage
* Deeply involvement in the new product development with cutting edge of new Gen CPU/AI server power architecture.
* Actively participate in hiring, developing and evaluating new hires / interns to develop their leadership skills
* Collaborate with design, marketing and product teams to provide high value to customers
* Provide technical support to assist customers to design with TI's Multiphase Controller \& Power stage Power solutions
* Write technical documents such as Datasheets, Application notes, etc.
* Contribute to the next generation Multiphase Controller \& Power stage specs definition by engaging with leading CPU solution vendors. Assess IC development tradeoff with design team and creating competition benchmarking.


**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Answer customer questions and support design\-in activities for released products by:
+ Debug of customer problems by re\-creating issues in our evaluation boards and/or customer boards
+ On\-site support for customer boards as required
+ Schematic and Layout Review of customer application
+ Forum and email questions from customers

* Closed work with CPU vendors to qualify the parts to PASS various AVL evaluation.
* Generate SIMPLIS or PSPICE Models for the Multiphase Controller \& Power stage products
* Perform Bench Characterization for new product developments (NPDE), including bench automation, hardware design and develop test techniques, such as
+ Participate in new silicon testing from an application perspective to ensure robustness of the product (i.e. destructive testing)
+ Provide product recommendations, competitive position and analysis for customers

* Participate in datasheet reviews to ensure completeness of datasheets in development by Systems Engineers
* Design EVM and internal evaluation boards to support correlation and evaluation activities of new products
* Train/Maintain the FAE's team knowledge of Multiphase Controller \& Power stage in order to provide local timely support.


 Write application notes and training collateral that explain different use cases, implementation and/or flexibility of multi\-phase controller \& Power Stage products
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Minimum requirements**
* Masters/PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE
* 1\+ years of application/system experience
* Experience in applications support of power products
* Strong technical background, with the ability to produce high quality technical documentation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience working on multi\-phase controller \& Power Stage product and solid understanding of power topology, such as DCAP\+
* Ability to create schematics using OrCAD or Altium; experience in developing PCB design with parasitic analysis a plus
* Demonstrated strong modeling skill
* Software skills in any major programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, LabView, etc.)
* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE or related field
* Demonstrated strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
* Strong time management skills that enable on\-time project delivery
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results


**About Us**
**Why TI?**
* Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics.
* We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI

description:
**Job Description**
 Network Architect / Lead Location: India (Bangalore / Ahmedabad / Remote) Job Function: IT – Infrastructure Engineering Date Posted: ASAP Requisition ID: 80192378 Remote, Hybrid or Onsite: \[Hybrid / Remote] About the Role Here at Kraft Heinz, we grow our people to grow our business, because we believe that great people make great companies. When you join our table, you can expect access to an array of holistic wellness benefits and perks, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, Business Resource Groups (BRGs) to help foster diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all employees, and an industry\-leading total rewards package that emphasizes a high discretionary bonus. Benefits begin immediately upon hire for salaried employees. Get a peek into life here at Kraft Heinz through our Instagram and TikTok channels! Network Architect at a glance… The Network Architect sets the technical direction for Kraft Heinz’s global enterprise network. This is a senior architecture role accountable for the reference designs, standards, and multi year technology roadmap that connect our manufacturing plants, distribution centers, corporate offices, and cloud environments. You’ll architect end\-to\-end across LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, wireless, network security, Zero Trust Branch, DDI, and Azure connectivity — translating business priorities into durable, scalable patterns that engineering teams can build against. You’ll lead architecture governance, influence multi\-year investment, and partner with leaders across Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing IT to modernize how our global sites connect, secure, and perform. What’s on the menu Architecture \& Strategy
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end target\-state architecture for the enterprise network: LAN, WAN, SD WAN, wireless, branch, data center, network security, and Azure connectivity.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, standards, and design patterns that engineering teams use to deliver consistently across the global estate.
* Set the multi\-year network technology roadmap aligned to business priorities, manufacturing modernization, and cloud strategy.
* Lead architecture governance and design reviews, ensuring solutions meet security, resiliency, performance, and cost objectives.
* Contribute to project planning, including investment cases, funding requests, and program\-level case studies. Zero Trust, Security \& Segmentation
* Architect Zero Trust Branch and enterprise segmentation strategies, including least privilege connectivity, micro\-segmentation, and identity\-aware access.
* Define network security architecture across platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass, integrating with the broader enterprise security and compliance program.
* Partner with the CISO organization to align network controls to Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and audit obligations.
* Establish and govern security protocols, business continuity patterns, and access control standards across the enterprise. Routing, DDI \& Core Services
* Establish enterprise routing architecture using BGP, OSPF, and modern segmentation patterns across hybrid environments.
* Define standards for DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (DDI), IP schema, naming, and service resiliency across on\-premises and cloud.
* Architect VPN, site\-to\-site, and remote\-access connectivity patterns for secure, scalable enterprise access.
* Optimize end\-to\-end network paths and traffic engineering for application performance and operational predictability. Cloud \& Hybrid Connectivity
* Lead Azure networking architecture, including VNET topology, peering, route control, private endpoints, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Define hybrid connectivity patterns between on\-premises plants, distribution centers, and cloud workloads.
* Partner with Cloud and platform teams to ensure network architecture enables — not constrains — application modernization. Branch \& Site Modernization
* Architect branch network modernization for our global manufacturing and distribution footprint, including SD\-WAN and Zero Trust Branch patterns.
* Improve user experience, application access, and operational simplicity at sites by reducing dependence on centralized backhaul.
* Define site reference designs that scale across geographies and plant types. Leadership \& Influence
* Mentor staff and senior engineers; raise the technical bar across the networking discipline.
* Partner with vendors and strategic technology partners on evaluations, proofs of concept, and roadmap alignment.
* Translate complex technical trade\-offs into clear, business\-relevant recommendations for senior leadership.
* Maintain authoritative network documentation — reference designs, topology diagrams, and standards — that the broader engineering organization can rely on. What you’ll need to be successful Must\-haves
* 10\+ years of network engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years in an architecture role at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated experience defining enterprise reference architectures and standards adopted across a multi\-site organization.
* Deep expertise across enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF), segmentation, WAN, SD\-WAN, and wireless.
* Strong network security architecture experience with platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass.
* Strong Azure networking experience, including VNet design, peering, private connectivity, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Experience with DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM), IP schema design, and core service resiliency.
* Proven experience architecting Zero Trust Branch, micro\-segmentation, or identity aware network access.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven ability to work across hybrid cloud and on\-premises environments in a global, distributed enterprise.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues clearly for both engineering and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement capabilities at the Director and VP level. Nice\-to\-haves
* Experience in manufacturing, CPG, or other industrial environments with significant OT/IT convergence considerations.
* Industry certifications such as CCIE, CCDE, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or TOGAF.
* Experience leading vendor evaluations and architecture proofs of concept.
* Familiarity with network automation, infrastructure as code, and enterprise observability platforms. Our Total Rewards philosophy Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values. Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance\-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents. The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Benefits: Coverage for employees (and their eligible dependents) through affordable access to healthcare, protection, and saving for the future — we offer plans tailored to meet you and your family’s needs. Travel: Up to 10–15%, as needed.

We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise\-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands\-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre\-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI\-native approaches into every engagement.

* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3\+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions


 \#\#\# Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
   

  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step\-by\-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands\-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi\-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real\-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Working Model
   

  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands\-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre\-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# About the Team
   

  

 AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI\-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
   

  

 We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
   

  

 \* \* \*
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Delivery (80%)


 Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi\-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end CX solutions encompassing contact flows, routing strategies, agent workspaces, real\-time and historical analytics, workforce management integration, and omnichannel orchestration

 The Advanced Services team provides exceptional outcomes and remarkable customer experience through "forward\-looking" technical services to optimize network reliability and performance for designated customers. We are passionate about enabling our customers towards a fast, risk\-free deployment of network services. We assist our customers to evaluate network for performance, scalability, and security and provides recommendations on network configurations and topologies to improve operational performance and identify/ mitigate major risk areas. Partnering on short\-term projects such as recommendation and implementation of new HPE Networking software and hardware features in the customer's network.

 Key responsibilities include the following, but are not limited to:
   

  

* The two main aspect of the role would be to represent HPE Networking customer service to the customer and as representative of the customer back to Juniper.
* Act as a single point of contact for post\-sales customer service issues in the account for the customer, partners, and account team. Understand customer lifecycle to deliver efficiency and effectiveness to the customer.

* Uses professional knowledge to review and assess open software defects. Discovers potential risks associated with the deployment plans and partner with the customer to develop mitigation plans.
* Delivers proactive consulting services such as technical analysis and recommendations (Impact assessment and analysis, health check analysis, software upgrade analysis, config review, etc…)

title: Sales Engineer (Presales)
description:
**About Us**
 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
   

  

 This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
   

  

 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
   

  

 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Role in a Nutshell**
 No two days are the same. You'll work hands\-on with market\-leading technologies, diagnose customers' toughest security challenges, and design solutions alongside partners — playing a central role in high\-impact projects from discovery through delivery. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical expertise and real business impact, this is your seat at the table.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive the win. Partner with partner sales teams to identify prospects, progress opportunities, and demonstrate Check Point's value proposition where it matters most — in front of the customer.
* Be the face of Check Point. Present at partner\-led customer events, workshops, and industry forums, bringing our story and our technology to life.
* Prove it out. Lead and co\-execute POCs and technical assessments alongside partner technical and presales teams, turning prospects into believers.
* Lead with value. Guide conversations that uncover real business problems and translate them into winning technical solutions — not just feature lists.
* Be the trusted advisor. Serve as a go\-to cybersecurity resource for partner technical communities, fielding tough technical questions and articulating solution benefits with confidence.
* Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on cybersecurity trends and the competitive landscape so every engagement is informed by what's happening now.
* Support the full cycle. Help partners respond to RFIs/RFPs, share best practices, and manage POCs so every customer gets an excellent experience from first conversation to close.
* Enable others. Train and enable partners and customers on the latest security technologies, multiplying your impact across every account you touch.
* Grow the account. Position Check Point's portfolio to maximize cross\-sell and upsell opportunities within partner accounts.
* Deliver excellence. Build solution designs and high\-impact proposals that reinforce Check Point's reputation as a security leader.
* Represent the brand. Show up at cybersecurity events and live demos as a credible, engaging voice for Check Point.


**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring**
* 8\+ years in technology organizations, including 4–6\+ years in systems engineering, presales, or partner engineering roles
* A genuinely customer\-centric mindset and a commitment to delivering an excellent customer experience
* A hands\-on attitude — you're willing to roll up your sleeves and work through technical blockers yourself
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving instincts
* Solid understanding of networking technologies, application architectures, and solution design
* Experience building end\-to\-end security solutions spanning network, endpoint, and cloud
* Excellent communication and presentation skills — you can flex between technical depth and executive clarity
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CCNP, CISSP, CCSA, CCSE)
* An engineering degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related discipline


**Why This Role**
 This is a role for someone who wants more than a technical title — you'll shape how partners and customers experience Check Point, own high\-visibility engagements end to end, and be recognized as the technical expert people turn to when the stakes are high. If you're energized by variety, ownership, and solving real security problems alongside great partners, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross\-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long\-term, trusted relationships.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner\-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in\-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab\-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision\-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go\-to\-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.


**About The Team**
 The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go\-to\-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.
